title: Label at an instruction index
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $c$ be an instruction identifier, and let $i$ be a natural number. If $i$ is less than the instruction count assigned to $c$, the resulting label is the indexed instruction label at position $i$; otherwise it is the next label assigned to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape symbols
caveat: The snippet uses an instruction-count function but does not include its definition.
